description: This Dart file defines a utility class `SupabaseConfig` that manages the initialization and access of a Supabase client within a Flutter application. It handles loading environment variables from `.env`, performs validation, and initializes the Supabase client.

classes.name: SupabaseConfig
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to initialize and retrieve the Supabase client instance, ensuring environment variables are properly loaded and validated.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Asynchronously initializes the Supabase client using environment variables defined in a loaded `.env` file. Throws an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the Supabase client after initialization.
